text:
support_jordan: Customer reported massive tail latency from EU customers starting ~08:12 UTC. They say requests are routed to us-west and auth tokens fail. Repro attached.
eng_oncall_ryan: can you paste the curl you used?
support_jordan: sure — they set an explicit prefer header but response shows us-west.
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token-eu>\" \\
  -H \"x-region-prefer: eu-west-1\" \\
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
support_jordan: response header `x-selected-region: us-west-2` and auth error `401` in body. Latency ~800ms.
maria_sre: :eyes: that's odd. If header was honored should be eu region. Any gateway/edge in front that rewrites headers?
sam_runtime: checked the routing logs for that trace id — saw connection reuse on Envoy sidecar to upstream pool, header was missing on the pooled connection, and downstream header not propagated for reused conn.
ops_gateway: we've seen a filter that normalizes region header for legacy clients — possible bug with header inheritance on keepalive. Sending snippet from proxy logs: 
```
[envoy][warning] route_match: no host rewrite, using last_request_header(x-region-prefer)=us-west-2
```
ops_gateway: looks like when upstream connection is reused we accidentally read previous request header from socket buffer instead of the new one.
support_jordan: customer on EU contract — this also caused billing to attribute usage to us-west bucket and trigger compliance alerts.
billing_kate: saw an invoice spike flagged at 08:12 UTC for that tenant under us-west. We need a mitigation asap to avoid more charge mismatches.
eng_oncall_ryan: mitigation ideas: 1) disable connection reuse for affected edge pool 2) deploy a hotfix to clear per-request header state in the rewrite filter 3) temporary rate-limiter/proxy rule forcing `x-selected-region` to prefer `x-region-prefer` header. Which is fastest?
sam_runtime: fastest is config flip to disable keepalive on that pool (ops_gateway can do). Hotfix for filter will take an emergency PR ~30-45m then can rollback.
ops_gateway: starting keepalive disable on pool-eu-edge now. Will report when drained.
eng_oncall_ryan: adding log-level debug for envoy header-rewrite filter so we can confirm.
deploy-bot: deploy request accepted: disable-keepalive/pool-eu-edge -> started (build 2026.3.17-ops.11).
maria_sre: also capture a minimal repro we can share with runtime team: include tcpdump of two requests back-to-back showing different `x-region-prefer` but same upstream conn where header read is stale.
support_jordan: attaching customer trace and curl output to support ticket #4642. Notified customer of temporary mitigation.
billing_kate: holding any auto-invoices for that tenant for the timeframe, will reconcile after root cause.
sam_runtime: root-cause hypothesis: Envoy L7 header rewrite filter maintains mutable state that isn't reset between requests on reused connection -> header inheritance -> wrong region selection -> auth token validated against wrong region auth service -> 401 + cross-region billing.
eng_oncall_ryan: next actions: ops to finish keepalive disable (in flight), sam to open hotfix PR referencing this thread, maria to collect tcpdumps and repro case, billing to hold invoices. I'll follow up in 30m. :thumbsup:
